text: This guide explains the current laws about cannabis in Germany.

Yes, recreational marijuana is legal since April 2024. There are many restrictions: Who can smoke: You must be at least 18 years old to have or grow cannabis. What you can possess: You can have up to 25 grams on you, and 50 grams at home. You can grow up to 3 plants at home. 3 plants per person, not per household. You can’t sell the cannabis that you grow. You can’t give the cannabis you grow to other people, not even for free. Where you can smoke: You can’t smoke around people who are under 18 years old. You can’t smoke in pedestrian zones between 7:00 and 20:00. You can’t smoke within sight of schools, kindergartens, playgrounds, sports facilities and cannabis clubs. You can smoke if you are out of sight of the entrances, or more than 100 metres away. There is currently no way to buy weed. There are no cannabis stores. You must grow it yourself or join a cannabis club.

title: Cannabis clubs
text: You can’t buy weed from a store. To get weed legally, you must join a cannabis club. You pay a membership fee, and you get a part of the cannabis the club produces. At the moment, it’s almost impossible to join a club. There are only a dozen clubs in Berlin, and they have long waiting lists. Most people still get cannabis from illegal sources. Rules for cannabis clubs: You must become a member of a cannabis club to get cannabis. You can only be a member of 1 cannabis club. Clubs are non-profit organisations, and need permission to operate. Clubs can have up to 500 members. Clubs can give members 25 grams of cannabis per day, or 50 grams per month. Clubs can give members under 22 years old 30 grams of cannabis per month. You can’t share the weed from cannabis clubs with other people. Clubs can only sell cannabis flowers, not cannabis products. Clubs can’t ship or deliver cannabis. Clubs can’t advertise or sponsor. To join a club, you must… Be at least 18 years old Be a resident for at least 6 months

title: Is medicinal marijuana legal?
text: Yes. Medical marijuana is legal. It is rarely prescribed. Only a few hundred people have a prescription. Legalisation made it easier to get a prescription. It’s currently the easiest way to buy cannabis. How to get a cannabis prescription

title: Is CBD legal?
text: Yes. CBD products are legal if they have less than 0.3% THC. You can buy CBD products online. You can find CBD flowers in some Spätis and head shops.

title: Are cannabis seeds legal?
text: Yes. Cannabis seeds are legal. You can also buy seeds from other EU countries. Growing your own cannabis is legal.

title: Are HHC and THCP legal?
text: No. The sale of Hexahydrocannabinol (HHC) and Tetrahydrocannabiphorol (THCP) is banned since 2024. Possession is still legal.

section: Can I bring weed from another country?
text: No. For example, you can’t buy weed in the Netherlands, and bring it to Germany. They sometimes check buses, trains and cars that come from the Netherlands. They sometimes use dogs to detect drugs. This might have changed with legalisation, but it’s not confirmed.
